title: Slice out the first 3 companies
description:
Slice out the first 3 companies from the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as first_three_companies(companies), returning a new list with the first 3 items of companies.
hints: Slicing a list with [:n] takes the first n items.
You don't need a starting index when slicing from the beginning.
expected_behavior: Returns the first 3 items of companies as a new list.
explanation: companies[:3] slices from the start of the list up to (but not including) index 3.
